_doc: HOENN_VERSION=emerald (emerald_world 2026-10-12, notes/EMERALD.md "Emerald's world"): the rooms and caves Emerald's outdoor maps lead to that data/hoenn_interiors.json lacks (Emerald-only: Battle Tents, Trainer Hill, Mirage Tower, Terra Cave, the Battle Frontier's buildings, the Mystery Events House, ...), found as rooms() finds Sapphire's but through Emerald's maps (converter/gba.py world_repo: HoennB2 names, Sapphire's ids for the rooms Sapphire has) -> data/emerald/hoenn_interiors.json "rooms" (deep-merged over data/hoenn_interiors.json by the Emerald world's readers), status "todo" and no zone: b2tools/world.py makes no door for them (the building or cave mouth stands closed) until a rooms agent builds the room and gives it a zone (notes/EMERALD.md work list). Sapphire's file is never written here, and the rooms Sapphire has keep their entries (their Emerald changes: data/versions.json "ground").
